saw_lines: Most people buying money advice start with a worry about their savings, then look for a guide they trust.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line, before the saver scrolls past to the offer.
Your 4 of 9 ads open on the same “hai investito in banca” hook, so one opener carries the account. Run 2 or 3 new angles from your guide against it.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 16 Nov 2026
points: 4 of 9 copy ads open on “hai investito in banca”, so one line carries the account and a saver who scrolls past it is gone. Test two or three new angles from your guide, like the cost of waiting, against it.

One exact copy runs in 4 of 9 ads, so the same pitch appears four times across the account. Keep the body copy, but change the opening line and the creative in each so each tests a different reason to click.

None of your 9 ads carries a proof number, so a new buyer has nothing concrete to trust before clicking. Pick one figure, such as a review count or orders shipped, and open the next batch with it on the creative.

Your median ad runs 123 words and the longest reaches 141, so the call to action and any offer sit far below where a phone screen cuts the text. Use two lines of copy, then the offer, and cut the rest.

ads_1: Fresh openers beyond the banca hook, tested against the cost of waiting
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Instagram and Youtube, your linked channels
